text:
Priya: @here quick idea — lunchtime challenge tomorrow: "Gravity Gauntlet" (30-min boulder circuit at the office wall) vs Park Loop 3K run. Loser brings snacks 😀
Alex: I'm in for the run. low-key pace, wanna keep it social. :runner:
Sam: Boulders for me. Need to work on crimps. Can we do two rounds? :crystal_ball:
Lily: Love it. If it's raining we can swap to the stairwell sprint.
Ben: Ooh stakes. I'll do whichever has more people. Also can someone bring a chalk bag for me?
Priya: Signup quick format: `@name - event - ETA`
Alex: `@Alex - park loop - 12:30`
Sam: `@Sam - gravity gauntlet - 12:30`
Lily: `@Lily - either - 12:35`
Ben: `@Ben - park loop - 12:40 (or boulders if more folks)`
Priya: Cool — looks like 2 run / 1 boulder + 1 flexible. I'll message facilities for spare chalk.
Priya: Also suggest we do a tiny handicap: add 30s per extra lap on the gauntlet to keep it fun.
Alex: :thumbsup: love a tiny handicap
FitBot: Reminder set — "Lunch Challenge: Gravity Gauntlet vs Park Loop" tomorrow 12:20. React with :bell: to confirm.
Sam: :bell:
Lily: :bell: see you all!
